description:
This kernel, truncated credit, at the point the ours search found, at five seeds.
One run per cell could not be read. The same point that scored 1025 under this kernel scored 261 once the seed was spent the reference's way -- same code, same parameters, a different draw -- and that spread is wider than any gap between the cells it was meant to measure. So the cells are drawn five times each, which is affordable now that truncated credit runs a two-million-step trial in five minutes rather than the twenty exact credit takes.
Read down a column for what a framework does with a point across draws, and across a row for whether the two frameworks differ by more than the draw does. Both kernels now begin each seed from the same parameters and the same environment resets, asserted leaf by leaf at zero last bits, so a row is a matched pair rather than two independent experiments that happen to share a number.
name: seeds-ours-point-on-ours
